card.name: Unit words right after a number
card.fires_on: The unit word straight after a numeric amount, such as mm, mg, miles, units or billion. It is strongest for mm in skin test reaction sizes and for mg in dose amounts.

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning approximately, equal or a number (in English and Chinese), so it seems to lower further quantity words after a measure.
card.plain: It notices the unit, like mg or mm, that follows a number, once the amount has already been given.
